verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Angular serves an llms.txt at https://angular.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured table of contents an agent can be pointed at. The docs site also advertises 'AI-forward resources and integrations', which supports the agent-oriented-docs side of the story. missing for 10: evidence of the full depth and coverage of the llms.txt content (e.g. a full-docs variant), concrete detail on the dedicated agent-oriented docs beyond a homepage claim, independent or community corroboration of agents using it effectively.
